priority: P1 — validate TagDuel lobby expiry at the exact five-minute boundary, physical lock release, scheduled public refresh and rejection of late acceptance.

behavior: A partially accepted lobby remains open one millisecond before LOBBY_MS and expires exactly at the five-minute boundary.
Expiry increments the revision once, clears state, removes tag_members locks for host and accepted partner, and makes currentTag return undefined for all four seats.
dueTags schedules the expired public message until markTagPublished records the new revision; repeated getTag calls do not increment revision again.
An Accept button rendered before expiry is rejected through handleTagComponent after the deadline and cannot restore the lobby or reacquire a seat lock.
implementation.validation: Temporary SQLite, createTagLobby, acceptTag through handleTagComponent, getTag(id, now), tagDeadline, dueTags, markTagPublished, tagPublicMessage and validateDiscordPayload.

limitations: Discord handler/builders are exercised offline; no live guild, token or Discord API call.
Temporary player profiles and SQLite only; no persistent player/deck/collection state is changed.
Test/evidence/workflow only; no runtime, card effect, catalogue, certification or allowlist changes.
